messages:
maria: FYI spotted two linked CVEs impacting cert-manager and nginx-ingress controller. cert-manager CVE-2026-0451 (privilege escalation), nginx CVE-2026-0452 (path traversal). Need triage and rollout plan for prod Dedicated + Private clusters.
ajay: thanks — can you paste versions and which clusters are on them?
maria: cert-manager v1.9.1 on prod-dedicated-us, prod-dedicated-eu; nginx-ingress 1.8.0 on same. staging clusters already on v1.10 for cert-manager.
devon: priority? cert-manager CE says local privilege escalation via webhook config, exploit requires write to clusterrolebindings. that's high for Private deployments.
sophia: nginx path traversal could affect hosted api endpoints if ingress rewrites are used. medium-high.
maria: proposal: patch cert-manager first (minor bump to 1.9.4 patch) across Dedicated canaries, then nginx. rollouts with RBAC audit enabled and KMS-integrated key usage flagged.
pranav: agree on order. we need to avoid breaking webhook admission flow. devon can you run smoke tests for cert-manager webhook behavior?
devon: will do. adding checklist:
- create canary namespace on prod-dedicated-us
- apply patched cert-manager deployment (image: quay.io/jetstack/cert-manager-controller:v1.9.4)
- validate admission webhook: `kubectl get validatingwebhookconfiguration cert-manager-webhook`
- run provisioning e2e (tls issuance + renewal)
- check audit logs for unexpected RBAC accesses

sophia: about audit logs — do we have sufficient retention/filters to catch post-patch RBAC changes? currently retention for Private is 90d, Hosted 30d. we should route cert-manager audit events to long-term storage for 60d at least.
ajay: agree. ops: can you add a dynamic audit webhook to forward cert-manager-related events to S3/GCS? we should also tag events with cluster_id and KMS_key_id.
sec-bot: Automated alert: KMS policy check for cluster prod-private-apac shows external key usage flagged. Recommend review before patching. (link: https://security.redwood.internal/kms/alerts/8891)
maria: thanks bot. pr to ops to freeze KMS external keys during canary: `iam put-policy --policy-file freeze-kms.json` (manual step). pranav: will own KMS gating.
pranav: quick Q — does cert-manager patch require any RBAC permission changes? release notes: mentions `clusterrole` permissions hardening; no new perms but removal of broad verbs for controller. we need to ensure existing service account still has needed verbs.
devon: I'll run `kubectl auth can-i` against the controller SA in canary namespace. example: `kubectl auth can-i create clusterrolebinding --as=system:serviceaccount:cert-manager:cert-manager`
sophia: also add an automated audit rule to flag any changes to ClusterRoleBindings during the patch window. we can run a dry-run alert rule: `audit.rules: objectRef.resource=="clusterrolebindings"`
ajay: rollout plan (concise):
1) create canary namespace + snapshot configs
2) patch cert-manager image on canary, run e2e, check KV cache + webhook flows
3) monitor audit + KMS usage for 6 hours
4) staggered patch of remainder clusters with 15m gaps, abort on RBAC anomalies

maria: what about nginx patch timing? should wait 24h after cert-manager sweep.
pranav: yes. nginx patch likely 1.8.1 -> 1.8.3, no RBAC but TLS rewrites test needed.
devon: test commands I will run against canary: `kubectl get pods -n cert-manager -o wide`, `kubectl logs -n cert-manager -l app=cert-manager` and `curl -k https://ingress-test.hosted.redwood/api/health` for nginx.
sophia: cross-team note: security review required for Private clusters due to KMS key policies. set meeting if we hit unexpected KMS alerts.
maria: volunteers for post-patch validation? I can do US, sophia can do EU, devon will own common smoke tests. ajay will coordinate audit dashboards. pranav handles KMS gating.
ajay: I'll create dashboard panels: RBAC change count, ClusterRoleBinding diffs, KMS key usage. share link when done.
pranav: I'll prepare a rollback playbook snippet: `kubectl rollout undo deployment cert-manager -n cert-manager` and `kubectl apply -f cert-manager-v1.9.1-manifest.yaml` + re-enable previous KMS policies.
maria: thanks all. tagging #oncall to schedule a preflight window for 2h tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. @oncall please ack.
sec-bot: Incident bot: Preflight window scheduled for 02:00 UTC tomorrow by maria. Reminder 30m before.
ajay: acked and added to runbook. will post final checklist in #eng-releases before patch.
pranav: one last note — update the compliance evidence doc after patch (audit export + KMS access logs). I will attach artifacts.
maria: closing loop: I'll open the triage PR with the canary manifest and assign to devon for tests. will update here with timestamps and results. thanks!
